content.title: iPhone 18 Pro LEAKS… Here’s What’s Coming
content.text: The iPhone 18 Pro is shaping up to be one of Apple’s biggest upgrades in years. From a brand new 2nm A20 Pro chip to a variable aperture camera, satellite web browsing, and even a brand new red color, there is a LOT to unpack. In this video, we break down all of the latest iPhone 18 Pro leaks and rumors so you know exactly what to expect ahead of Apple’s September event. We’re talking about: • Smaller Dynamic Island with under-display Face ID changes • New LTPO+ display technology for better battery life • A variable aperture camera for improved photography • Apple’s new C2 modem and N2 wireless chip • Satellite web browsing capabilities • A thicker Pro Max with a larger battery • First look at dummy models and foldable iPhone leaks If these leaks are accurate, the iPhone 18 Pro could be one of the most complete upgrades Apple has released in years. What feature are you most excited about?
